description: Re-ground on .faf content — re-score with the always-33 faf-kernel (33 slots; slotignored slots drop out), report drift vs an optional baseline score, and return a stamped re-ground. The explicit re-grounding primitive for long sessions: drift → refresh → re-grounded. Built for Grok, by request.

baseline.description: Optional last-known score (0-100). When provided, the drift delta (current - baseline) is reported.

content.description: Raw .faf YAML content to re-ground on.

verbatim.description: When true, return the full .faf content verbatim with the stamp. Default false (stamped delta + summary).

name: refresh_faf
title: Re-ground on .faf content (drift → refresh → re-grounded)
